Junior AI Engineer - Arbisoft (Lahore, hybrid)

About the role
We are looking for a junior engineer to help build LLM-backed product features.

Requirements
- Strong Python
- Experience building REST APIs (FastAPI or similar)
- Familiarity with LLM APIs and prompt engineering
- Testing discipline (pytest)
- Comfortable with SQL databases

Nice to have
- Experience with agent frameworks or the Model Context Protocol
- Kubernetes / cloud deployment experience
- Front-end familiarity (React)
